description: This file is a shell script used for performance testing of the Git filesystem monitor (FSMonitor). It sets up repositories, configures FSMonitor and untracked cache, and runs performance tests on Git commands to measure their execution times under different configurations.

methods.name: enable_uc
methods.description: Enables the untracked cache in the specified Git repository.

methods.name: disable_uc
methods.description: Disables the untracked cache in the specified Git repository.

methods.name: start_fsm
methods.description: Starts the FSMonitor daemon for the repository.

methods.name: stop_fsm
methods.description: Stops the FSMonitor daemon and disables FSMonitor in the repository.

methods.name: do_status
methods.description: Runs 'git status' in the repository and measures performance.

methods.name: do_matrix
methods.description: Performs a series of Git operations (checkout, modify, add, commit, reset, create untracked files, clean) under different configurations and measures performance.
